configurePresets.name: win64-base
configurePresets.description: Shared toolchain for every win64 preset: Visual Studio generator, x64 host and target. RelWithDebInfo is the default configuration, picked by the build presets.

configurePresets.name: win64-vendored-ruby
configurePresets.description: Compiles the vendored CRuby in third_party/cruby. A prebuilt drop-in in bind/external is ignored, so both interpreters can be built from one checkout without moving files.

configurePresets.name: win64-external-ruby
configurePresets.description: Links the prebuilt CRuby in bind/external and turns YJIT on. Configure fails when the drop-in is absent rather than falling back to the bundled interpreter.
